questions.prompt: How many total individual grains of rice are contained within a standard 50-kilogram commercial jute sack of uncooked long-grain white rice?
reasoning: A single grain of typical long-grain white rice weighs approximately 0.02 grams.
A 50-kilogram sack contains 50,000 grams of rice.
Dividing 50,000 grams by 0.02 grams per grain gives 2,500,000 grains.

questions.prompt: How many total individual plastic bricks are contained within a standard commercial master shipping carton holding 100 individual boxed sets of a popular building block toy?
reasoning: A standard boxed toy set of building blocks contains an average of 600 individual plastic bricks.
A master shipping carton holds 100 of these boxed sets.
Multiplying 100 boxed sets by 600 bricks per set yields 60,000 bricks.

questions.prompt: How many total individual wooden toothpicks are manufactured by all toothpick production facilities operating within the country of Portugal in a single year?
reasoning: Portugal has a few specialized timber and wood-products mills that supply domestic and regional markets.
An average mill produces roughly 300 million toothpicks annually.
Across 4 major mills operating nationwide, total annual production reaches approximately 1,200,000,000 toothpicks.
